title: Venezuelan Cheese Quesadillas
description: A delicious and classic Venezuelan dish made with melted cheese and crispy tortillas.

ingredients.name: Optional: Chopped Fresh Cilantro or Scallions

instructions: 1. In a large frying pan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter or heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
2. Place a tortilla in the pan and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
3. Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese.
4. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
5. Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
6. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and cheese.
7. Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot with your favorite toppings.
8. Optional: Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions.
